name: New Brunswick

flag.description: A gold field with a red band across the top carrying a gold lion; below, a black ancient galley with oars sails on wavy blue and white water.
flag.symbolism: The lion recalls the province's ties to Britain and to the German duchy of Brunswick, and the galley stands for shipbuilding and seafaring.

hook: New Brunswick sails a black galley across a gold flag under a red lion band; Prince Edward Island has the same lion band but oak trees on white below.
trivia: New Brunswick is the only officially bilingual province in Canada.
The province was named in 1784 in honor of King George III, who was also Duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg.
